anomalies.expected: The specification's power section states the VCC–GND decoupling bank is all capacitors: 'C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C8 — 100 nF each, VCC–GND (local bypass)'. The position R11 occupies should hold a 100 nF bypass capacitor (C3); a resistor is the wrong component type for a decoupling position, and C3 is missing.

anomalies.impact: The intended 100 nF high-frequency bypass (C3) is absent, weakening decoupling of the VCC rail, while the 10 kΩ R11 instead acts as a continuous DC load on the rail (and provides no decoupling). This can raise rail noise and reduce stability margin for the MCU/peripherals relative to the reference design.
